assets: memory_record and artifact_object content of every scope
provenance tuples (canonical_source_id, publisher_id, independence_group, resolver_version, created_by_activity)
canonical scope bindings and membership rows
trust_boundaries: retrieved/untrusted content -> policy engine (content must never alter policy)

attacker_capabilities.name: authenticated caller from a neighboring tenant/workspace/goal
attacker_capabilities.capability: issues well-formed retrieval requests authorized only in its own scope; may guess or know foreign scope ids
attacker_capabilities.prevention: effective scope resolved from canonical membership rows only; per-row policy predicate / own-scope index access; canonical deny form
attacker_capabilities.detection: retrieval.deny audit events with generic_reason_class; ISO1/ISO2 counters derived from raw observations
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: side channels outside the measured surface (host-level timing, storage telemetry) are out of the local model

attacker_capabilities.name: caller holding a valid foreign object id
attacker_capabilities.capability: replays a leaked valid id of another scope to probe existence or content
attacker_capabilities.prevention: deny path identical to nonexistent-id control (same body, same code path order); no existence hint in detail or timing above the frozen tolerance
attacker_capabilities.detection: probe A deny-equivalence and bounded timing comparison against the nonexistent control
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: timing tolerance is a bounded local statistic, not a proof that all side channels are absent
attacker_capabilities.observable_security_event: retrieval.deny with generic_reason_class=empty, byte-identical to the control

attacker_capabilities.name: forged scope/filter parameters
attacker_capabilities.capability: supplies scope, tenant or filter parameters that claim a wider or different scope
attacker_capabilities.prevention: caller-supplied scope can only equal the canonical effective scope; anything else denies (ISO7/ISO8)
attacker_capabilities.detection: ISO7 counter (scope widening attempts that changed the effective scope) and ISO8 counter (unknown/malformed scope resolved to a default)
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: none identified inside the model; canonical membership rows are trusted inputs

attacker_capabilities.name: stale cache/projection after revoke or move
attacker_capabilities.capability: abuses a cache or projection entry filled before a revoke/move/supersede to keep reading data through the old scope
attacker_capabilities.prevention: cache keys and entries bound to (scope, policy_epoch); epoch bump at the committed invalidation point; hit revalidates the epoch (ISO3/ISO4)
attacker_capabilities.detection: ISO3/ISO4 counters; probe B exercises the exact sequence warm-cache -> revoke/move -> old-scope read
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: the <=5s cross-component revocation SLO is S1-008 scope and is not claimed here; this model proves the logical invalidation point only
attacker_capabilities.observable_security_event: retrieval.deny (generic_reason_class=empty) after the committed invalidation point; violation = stale entry served

attacker_capabilities.name: shared-index enumeration via count/rank/error/timing
attacker_capabilities.capability: infers foreign data through aggregate fields, pagination totals, per-case error detail or bounded timing differences
attacker_capabilities.prevention: aggregates computed only after the per-row policy predicate; canonical deny form; frozen timing tolerance on the foreign/nonexistent pair
attacker_capabilities.detection: ISO2 leakage scan of response payloads (count/rank/snippet/metadata fields); probe C post-filter candidate must be detected
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: absence of a measured signal is not proof of absence of all side channels
attacker_capabilities.observable_security_event: retrieval.deny/allow with protected fields absent from payloads; any leak = FAIL

attacker_capabilities.name: background indexer with excessive read scope
attacker_capabilities.capability: a background job reads or writes across scopes beyond its authorization, or drops provenance during reindex
attacker_capabilities.prevention: background jobs run under a per-scope indexer authorization context; writes are scope-bound; provenance preservation is checked per entry (ISO5/ISO6)
attacker_capabilities.detection: ISO5/ISO6 counters on background-path observations; probe D provenance-loss candidate
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: operator-level compromise of the indexer process is out of scope (operator boundary is a documented profile limit)
attacker_capabilities.observable_security_event: reindex.audit per scope with entry counts; unverifiable entries rejected

attacker_capabilities.name: malicious/untrusted retrieved content attempting to alter policy
attacker_capabilities.capability: content, snippets or metadata returned by retrieval try to inject policy decisions or expand scope on later requests
attacker_capabilities.prevention: external content is untrusted (repo invariant 6): retrieval never lets content modify the policy engine, membership rows or scope binding; policy decisions use canonical rows only
attacker_capabilities.detection: policy engine state hash before/after retrieval paths; content fields are opaque bytes in the model
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: downstream injection risks (prompt injection through snippets) are gateway/knowledge-gate scope (S1-011), not retrieval topology

attacker_capabilities.name: operator/admin boundary
attacker_capabilities.capability: an operator or platform admin requests cross-scope reads outside their authorization
attacker_capabilities.prevention: out of the MVP contract: admin-visible retrieval is a documented profile-C boundary handled by S1-018 (MLS/TEE attested indexer); in this ticket the admin path is denied like any other
attacker_capabilities.detection: same ISO counters; admin-blind indexing is explicitly non-scope
attacker_capabilities.residual_risk: profile-C requirements may constrain the selected contract; recorded as a profile-compatibility dimension, not solved here

attacker_motivation: read or infer protected data of a scope for which the caller holds no membership, or keep reading data after revocation
out_of_scope_threats: cryptographic non-interference claims from the local timing test
evidence_policy: each probe records prevention, detection, residual risk and the observed security event; absence of an observed leak is never treated as proof that no side channel exists
